_note: Two 1920x1080 projectors, side by side with a 240px soft-edge overlap. Canvas = 1920 + 1920 - 240 = 3600 wide. Adjust the overlap physically first (point the projectors so their images overlap by ~12.5%), then fine-tune corners and blend here.

outputs._note: Canvas x 0..1920. Its right 240px (= 0.125 of 1920) overlaps projector-2.
Canvas x 1680..3600 (starts 240px before projector-1 ends). Mirrored blend on its left edge.

layers._note: ONE grid across the whole canvas: in the overlap, both projectors draw the same lines, so misalignment shows up as doubled lines.
